bug_info.bug_desc: In the CVXIF valid generation block, cvxif_off_instr_n is assigned to orig_instr[i] (a single-bit slice of the instruction word) instead of the full 32-bit instruction orig_instr_i[i]. This causes the offloaded instruction value propagated to the CVXIF coprocessor and subsequently into exception tval to be truncated to a single bit, leading to incorrect trap values (e.g., mtval=1 instead of the full instruction encoding).
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the assignment of cvxif_off_instr_n from orig_instr[i] to orig_instr_i[i] to capture the complete 32-bit instruction word for the corresponding issue port.
